commits.message:
Add new skills and workflows for resource management and testing

- Create e2e-test-runner skill for end-to-end testing procedures.
- Add example-generator skill to generate Terraform example configurations.
- Implement issue-to-resource-spec skill for parsing resource requests from GitHub issues.
- Introduce naming-rules-drift-check skill to verify Azure naming rules against current definitions.
- Develop pr-compliance-check skill to validate pull request compliance with project standards.
- Establish pre-release-validation skill for comprehensive checks before release tagging.
- Create readme-resource-table skill to update resource status in README.md.
- Add regression-test-runner skill for running full CI test suite and reporting results.
- Implement release-notes-generator skill for generating release notes from CHANGELOG.md.
- Create resource-bulk-import skill for batch importing Azure resources into resourceDefinition.json.
- Develop resource-completeness-check skill to compare resource definitions against existing resources.
- Introduce resource-diff-report skill for comparing different versions of resourceDefinition.json.
- Add semver-assessment skill to analyze changes and determine semantic version bumps.
- Implement test-failure-diagnosis skill for diagnosing test failures and suggesting fixes.
- Create workflows for contributor welcome, issue-to-PR automation, nightly regression testing, PR review, release validation, and weekly Azure sync.

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+---
+description: |
+  Nightly regression test workflow. Runs the full test suite and E2E tests
+  on the main branch. Creates a GitHub issue if any tests fail, with
+  detailed failure information for rapid diagnosis.
+
+on:
+  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: write
+
+network: defaults
+
+tools:
+  github:
+    lockdown: true
+    toolsets: [issues]
+  bash:
+    - "make *"
+    - "go *"
+    - "grep *"
+    - "cat *"
+    - "head *"
+    - "tail *"
+
+safe-outputs:
+  create-issue:
+    title-prefix: "[nightly-regression] "
+    labels: [bug, automated, nightly]
+    close-older-issues: true
+
+steps:
+  - name: Build and test
+    run: |
+      echo "🔨 Building provider..."
+      make build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-output.txt
+      BUILD_EXIT=$?
+
+      echo "🧪 Running CI tests..."
+      make test_ci 2>&1 | tee /tmp/test-ci-output.txt
+      TEST_EXIT=$?
+
+      echo "🔬 Running E2E quick tests..."
+      make test_e2e_quick 2>&1 | tee /tmp/e2e-output.txt
+      E2E_EXIT=$?
+
+      echo "BUILD_EXIT=$BUILD_EXIT" >> /tmp/results.env
+      echo "TEST_EXIT=$TEST_EXIT" >> /tmp/results.env
+      echo "E2E_EXIT=$E2E_EXIT" >> /tmp/results.env
+
+      # Extract test summary lines
+      grep -E "^(ok|FAIL|---)" /tmp/test-ci-output.txt > /tmp/test-summary.txt 2>/dev/null || true
+      grep -E "^(ok|FAIL|---)" /tmp/e2e-output.txt >> /tmp/test-summary.txt 2>/dev/null || true
+
+source: local
+engine: copilot
+---
+
+# Nightly Regression
+
+Run nightly regression tests on the main branch and report failures.
+
+## Process
+
+1. Read the test results from `/tmp/results.env` and `/tmp/test-summary.txt`
+2. If ALL exit codes are 0: no action needed, exit quietly
+3. If ANY exit code is non-zero:
+   - Analyze the failure output files (`/tmp/build-output.txt`, `/tmp/test-ci-output.txt`, `/tmp/e2e-output.txt`)
+   - Identify which tests failed and extract error details
+   - Create a GitHub issue with:
+     - Title: `[nightly-regression] Test failures on main — <date>`
+     - Failed test names and error messages
+     - Suggested investigation steps
+     - Links to relevant test files

commits.message:
ci+docs: fix nightly regression, agentic workflow firewall paths, doc accuracy

Workflow fixes (resolves #462, #465, #468):

- nightly-regression: add setup-go + setup-terraform pre-agent steps so make test_e2e_quick can find the terraform binary; rework run-script to use 'set -o pipefail' and capture per-suite exit codes through tee (assignment after tee was always seeing tee's $?, masking failures as exit 0). Step now always exits 0 so the agent can decide whether to file an issue.

- issue-arborist: move pre-downloaded issues.json + issues-schema.json out of /tmp/gh-aw/issues-data/ (firewall-reserved by gh-aw v0.72.1) to ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.gh-aw-data/, and update all path references in the agent prompt body.

- weekly-azure-sync: move python3+curl resource-discovery work into a pre-agent step that writes pre-computed files to ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.gh-aw-data/{supported,azurerm,missing,counts.env,caf-abbreviations.html}; tighten agent bash allowlist to read-only tools (cat/grep/head/tail/sort/comm/wc) since python3 is denied inside the firewall sandbox.

All 3 lock files recompiled with 'gh aw compile --approve' (v0.72.1) including the new hashicorp/setup-terraform@v4 action approval recorded in .github/aw/actions-lock.json. Compile output: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Documentation accuracy + Doc-Ops pass:

- README.md: fix 3 run-on regressions from PR #469's bulk substitution where missing newlines collapsed adjacent list items / fenced-code lines; replace broken 'make test_resource_constraints' references with 'make test_resource_matrix' (whose Makefile help string already covers constraint validation); add missing 'error_when_exceeding_max_length' parameter row that was on the schema but absent from the table.

- TESTING.md: remove 2 references to integration test files that do not exist (integration_cross_resource_test.go, integration_naming_convention_types_test.go); add integration_all_resources_complete_test.go; soften 1 hedging phrase per writing-style instructions.

- E2E_IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md, e2e/README.md: minor style fixes (hedging, dangling empty-body bullet).

- docs/index.md, docs/resources/{azurecaf_name,azurecaf_naming_convention}.md, docs/data-sources/azurecaf_name.md, .github/CONTRIBUTING.md: align documented resource count from '400+' to actual '401' (verified via 'jq length resourceDefinition.json'); makes the line-44 CHANGELOG claim from PR #469 actually accurate.

- .gitignore: exclude .copilot-tracking/ working notes from version control.

- CHANGELOG.md: add [Unreleased] entries documenting all of the above.
